硫、二氧化硫、浓硫酸的性质与不同价态含硫物质的转化: Sulfur, Sulfur Dioxide and Concentrated Sulfuric Acid: Properties and Interconversion of Oxidation States
硫、二氧化硫、浓硫酸 · 不同价态含硫物质的转化: Sulfur, SO₂, concentrated H₂SO₄ · interconversion of sulfur oxidation states
2H₂SO₄(浓) + Cu =Δ= CuSO₄ + SO₂↑ + 2H₂O ·: 2H₂SO₄(conc.) + Cu =Δ= CuSO₄ + SO₂↑ + 2H₂O · oxidation states of S: −2 / 0 / +4 / +6
同样是硫，为什么有时它是黄色固体、有时让品红褪成无色、有时又跑进铁粉里？: It's all sulfur, so why is it sometimes a yellow solid, sometimes bleaching magenta to colorless, and sometimes combining with iron powder?
−2 是 H₂S / Na₂S，0 是硫单质，+4 是 SO₂ / H₂SO₃，: −2 is H₂S / Na₂S, 0 is elemental sulfur, +4 is SO₂ / H₂SO₃, +6 is H₂SO₄ / CuSO₄
0 → +4（O₂ 燃烧）、+4 → +6（酸性 KMnO₄）；浓硫酸自己也是强: 0 → +4 (burning in O₂), +4 → +6 (acidified KMnO₄); concentrated sulfuric acid is itself a strong oxidizer
品红褪色且加热能复原、石蕊只变红不褪、KMnO₄ 褪色、淡黄色浑浊、粉末红热变黑: Magenta bleaches and returns on heating, litmus only turns red without bleaching, KMnO₄ decolorizes, pale-yellow turbidity, powder glows red and turns black
一条气路 + 三支检验管 + 一个价态视窗: One gas line + three test tubes + one oxidation-state window
整体 · 四个站位：硫往铁里走、浓硫酸往 SO₂ 走、两种价态往中间走: Overview · four stations: sulfur goes into iron, concentrated sulfuric acid goes to SO₂, two oxidation states meet in the middle
拨一个开关，颜色、现象和读数一起变: Flip one switch and the colors, observations and readings all change together
全对！记住这条线：价态定身份，往上走加氧化剂、往下走加还原剂，现象就是这一步的收: All correct! Remember this line: oxidation state sets identity; add an oxidizer to go up, a reducer to go down, and the observation is the receipt for that step.
建议回看主线：先看硫与铁（0 → −2）、再看浓硫酸与铜（+6 → +4）、最后: Suggested review of the main thread: first sulfur and iron (0 → −2), then concentrated sulfuric acid and copper (+6 → +4), finally SO₂ only turning litmus red while decolorizing KMnO₄ (+4 → +6).

红热从这里向外蔓延: The red glow spreads outward from here
螺旋铜丝（塞侧凹槽）: Copper wire coil (in the stopper-side groove)
浸 NaOH 溶液的棉团: Cotton plug soaked in NaOH solution
陶土网站：混合粉末条、灼热玻璃棒、红热锋、冷却后的黑色固体: Clay-gauze station: strip of mixed powder, hot glass rod, red-glow front, black solid after cooling

示意放大（S 的价态 −2 / 0 / +4 / +6 与得失电子）: Magnified view (S oxidation states −2 / 0 / +4 / +6 and electron gain/loss)
颜色残留 — 通入 SO₂ 量: Color remaining vs SO₂ passed in
陶土网上一小堆混好的硫粉与铁粉（0.5 g + 1.0 g，堆成条状），旁边一根: A small pile of mixed sulfur and iron powder on clay gauze (0.5 g + 1.0 g, in a strip), with a glass rod to be heated red and two wide-mouth bottles beside it; once touched with the hot rod, the red glow spreads outward from the contact point (Lab Activity 5 step 3)
浓硫酸与铜 · 三支检验管: Concentrated sulfuric acid and copper · three test tubes
教材图5-6 整套：铁架台夹住的加热试管（2 mL 浓硫酸 + 塞侧凹槽的螺旋铜: The full setup of Fig. 5-6: a heated test tube clamped on a stand (2 mL concentrated sulfuric acid + copper wire coil in the stopper groove) + alcohol lamp + delivery tube → three receiving tubes side by side (magenta / purple litmus / acidified KMnO₄), each mouth plugged with cotton soaked in NaOH solution
两支试管各 1 mL Na₂S 溶液，两支胶头滴管（H₂SO₃ / 酸性 KMn: Two test tubes each with 1 mL Na₂S solution, two droppers (H₂SO₃ / acidified KMnO₄), mouths plugged with NaOH cotton; pale-yellow turbidity appears after adding (Lab Activity 5 step 1)
台面后上方的圆窗：S 的四层价态（−2 / 0 / +4 / +6）、每层的含硫: Circular window above the back of the bench: the four oxidation-state levels of S (−2 / 0 / +4 / +6), the sulfur species at each level, arrows and reagents (oxidizers up, reducers down) and the electrons gained or lost beside each arrow
桌上这四摊东西，哪一摊在把硫「往上抬」、哪一摊在把它「往下压」？: Of the four setups on the bench, which is "lifting" sulfur up and which is "pushing" it down?
四个站位都在：① 陶土网上一小堆混好的粉末 + 一根玻璃棒；② 铁架台夹着的加热: All four stations are present: ① a small pile of mixed powder on clay gauze + a glass rod; ② a heated test tube on a stand (2 mL concentrated sulfuric acid + copper wire coil), an alcohol lamp beneath, a delivery tube into three receiving tubes side by side with cotton plugs; ③ two test tubes of 1 mL Na₂S solution + two droppers; ④ the oxidation-state window above the back of the bench. Main reading 100.0 % (magenta still red, not yet heated)
常温 → 加热 · 导管通入检验管 · 棉团吸收尾气: Room temperature → heating · delivery tube into test tubes · cotton absorbs tail gas
从左到右就是三件事：① 硫往下走（0 → −2）、② 硫往上走（+6 → +4）: Left to right it's three things: ① sulfur goes down (0 → −2), ② sulfur goes up from the top down (+6 → +4), ③ both ends move to the middle (−2 and +4 → 0).
主站是 ②：一条导管把「发生」和「检验」连起来，气体是同一股；三支接收管同高并排: The main station is ②: one delivery tube connects "generation" and "testing", so it's the same stream of gas; the three receiving tubes are side by side at the same height so they can be compared.
品红、石蕊、KMnO₄ 对同一股 SO₂ 的反应各不相同 —— 第 6 步会把三: Magenta, litmus and KMnO₄ each respond differently to the same SO₂; step 6 compares all three tubes at once.
去掉这一步：学生不知道自己在看哪一摊，后面每换一个开关都对不上位置。: Skip this step and students don't know which setup they are looking at, so each later switch doesn't match a place.
常考：含硫物质的价态与类别（H₂S / S / SO₂ / H₂SO₄）一一对应: Often tested: matching oxidation states with sulfur species (H₂S / S / SO₂ / H₂SO₄).
这就是必修第二册第五章第一节 + 实验活动5 的四个实验，摆在同一张台面上：一个: These are the four experiments of Required Book 2 Ch. 5 Sec. 1 + Lab Activity 5 on one bench: sulfur with iron, concentrated sulfuric acid, three tests for SO₂, and −2 and +4 comproportionating to 0.
把烧红的玻璃棒往粉末条一端一触，为什么整条都红了？: Touch one end of the powder strip with a red-hot glass rod: why does the whole strip glow red?
把玻璃棒烧红，触到粉末条的一端（起始没加热）: Heat the glass rod red and touch it to one end of the powder strip (not heated at the start)
玻璃棒烧红后触到粉末条的一端：红热从触及处向外蔓延，慢慢整条都红热；冷却后得到黑: The red-hot rod touches one end of the strip: the red glow spreads outward from the contact point until the whole strip glows; after cooling a black solid remains. S goes from 0 down to −2 (gains 2 electrons); the main reading stays 100.0 % (magenta unchanged)
灼热玻璃棒触及一端 · 硫粉 0.5 g + 铁粉 1.0 g: Hot glass rod touches one end · sulfur powder 0.5 g + iron powder 1.0 g
铁粉与硫粉按 1.0 g : 0.5 g 混，是为了让铁过量、硫用完（教材用量）: Iron and sulfur powders are mixed 1.0 g : 0.5 g so that iron is in excess and sulfur is used up (textbook amounts).
红热一旦起来就能自己蔓延：反应放热，产物的温度足以点燃邻近的粉末。: Once the glow starts it spreads by itself: the reaction is exothermic and the hot product ignites the neighboring powder.
「红热」说明这一步放热，与它「S 被还原」并不矛盾 —— 放热放的是能量，得失的: "Glowing red" shows this step releases heat, which doesn't contradict "S is reduced": energy is released, electrons are gained (2 per S).
去掉这一步：学生只记得「硫是黄色的」，不知道硫也能当氧化剂把铁氧化成 FeS。: Skip this step and students only remember "sulfur is yellow", not that sulfur can also act as an oxidizer and oxidize iron to FeS.
高频：硫与变价金属反应（Fe 只到 +2，生成 FeS）；硫在这类反应里作氧化剂: Frequently tested: sulfur with variable-valence metals (Fe only reaches +2, forming FeS); sulfur acts as the oxidizer in such reactions.
硫与铁直接化合生成硫化亚铁：S 由 0 降到 −2、Fe 由 0 升到 +2，所: Sulfur combines directly with iron to form iron(II) sulfide: S falls from 0 to −2 and Fe rises from 0 to +2, so in this step sulfur is the oxidizer and iron the reducer. Textbook: "Sulfur is chemically fairly active and reacts with many metals and nonmetals."
一样是硫酸，为什么这一支能冒出气体、还能把品红漂白？: It's all sulfuric acid, so why does this tube give off gas that bleaches magenta?
酒精灯已经点着：把通入的 SO₂ 从 0 拖到 10、20、30 mL，盯住品红: The alcohol lamp is lit: drag the SO₂ passed in from 0 to 10, 20, 30 mL and watch the magenta and two readings
通 0 → 5 → 10 → 30 mL：颜色残留 100.0 → 50.0 →: Passing 0 → 5 → 10 → 30 mL: color remaining 100.0 → 50.0 → 0.0 → 0.0 %, volume passed 0.0 → 5.0 → 10.0 → 30.0 mL; the delivery tube keeps bubbling and the magenta fades layer by layer to colorless, while the other two tubes haven't received gas yet. S oxidation state +6 → +4
加热 · 浓硫酸 2 mL + 螺旋铜丝 · 棉团吸收: Heated · 2 mL concentrated sulfuric acid + copper wire coil · cotton absorption
这里出来的气体是 SO₂，不是氢气 —— 浓硫酸与金属反应不放氢气（放氢气要用稀: The gas coming out is SO₂, not hydrogen: concentrated sulfuric acid doesn't release hydrogen with metals (that needs dilute sulfuric acid).
品红 10.0 mL 就褪完，再通到 30.0 mL 也不会更白：褪色有上限，颜: 10.0 mL bleaches the magenta completely, and passing up to 30.0 mL doesn't make it whiter: bleaching has a limit and the color stays at 0.0 %.
浓硫酸与铜的反应里只有一半的硫酸被还原（另一半起酸的作用生成 CuSO₄），所以: In the reaction of concentrated sulfuric acid with copper only half the acid is reduced (the other half acts as an acid to form CuSO₄), which is why H₂SO₄ has a 2 in front.
去掉这一步：学生会把「酸和金属就出氢气」套到浓硫酸上，也会以为冒出来的是酸雾。: Skip this step and students apply "acid plus metal gives hydrogen" to concentrated sulfuric acid, or think the gas is acid mist.
高频：浓硫酸与铜的方程式与配平；SO₂ 的漂白现象（品红褪色）。: Frequently tested: equation and balancing for concentrated sulfuric acid with copper; the bleaching observation of SO₂ (magenta fades).
加热时浓硫酸把铜氧化：一份硫酸被还原成 SO₂（S 由 +6 降到 +4），另一: When heated, concentrated sulfuric acid oxidizes copper: one portion of the acid is reduced to SO₂ (S from +6 to +4) and another acts as an acid to form CuSO₄. The SO₂ produced forms an unstable colorless substance with magenta, so it fades; this is what "concentrated sulfuric acid is strongly oxidizing" means.
一样是「硫酸 + 铜 + 加热」，换成稀的行不行？: Same "sulfuric acid + copper + heat": would dilute acid work?
现在锅里是稀硫酸（起始就是稀的）：把酸换成浓硫酸，看品红还褪不褪: The tube now holds dilute sulfuric acid (dilute at the start): switch to concentrated and see whether the magenta still fades
稀硫酸这一侧一点反应都没有：管里不冒泡、颜色残留停在 100.0 %、已通入体积: Nothing happens on the dilute side: no bubbles, color stays at 100.0 %, volume passed 0.0 mL, and the small reading says "almost no reaction". Switch to concentrated acid and it bubbles vigorously at once, color drops to 0.0 %, volume reaches 20.0 mL, S goes +6 → +4. Turn the alcohol lamp off and concentrated acid doesn't react either
稀硫酸 + Cu：不反应 | 2H₂SO₄(浓) + Cu =Δ= CuSO₄: Dilute H₂SO₄ + Cu: no reaction　|　2H₂SO₄(conc.) + Cu =Δ= CuSO₄ + SO₂↑ + 2H₂O
浓硫酸 + 加热，两个条件缺一不可: Concentrated acid + heat: both conditions are required
两个条件缺一不可：浓硫酸 + 加热。少一个就一点气体也没有（关掉酒精灯，浓硫酸同: Both conditions are required: concentrated sulfuric acid + heat. Without either there's no gas at all (with the lamp off, concentrated acid doesn't react either).
判据是「品红褪不褪、已通入体积是不是 0.0 mL」，不是「有没有气泡」—— 稀: The test is "does the magenta fade, is the volume passed 0.0 mL", not "are there bubbles": dilute acid gives off steam when heated too.
浓硫酸有很强的氧化性，因为硫在 +6 最高价、还能把别人氧化；稀硫酸里硫酸已经电: Concentrated sulfuric acid is strongly oxidizing because sulfur is at its highest state, +6, and can oxidize others; in dilute acid the H₂SO₄ has ionized to SO₄²⁻ and is far less oxidizing, reacting only with active metals to release hydrogen.
去掉这一步：学生背「酸 + 金属 → 氢气」，考到浓硫酸与铜就写成 H₂。教材思: Skip this step and students recite "acid + metal → hydrogen" and write H₂ for concentrated sulfuric acid with copper. Question 2 of the textbook's Think and Discuss is about exactly this.
高频：浓硫酸与铜必须「浓 + 加热」；稀硫酸与铜不反应；实验室制氢气为什么用稀硫: Frequently tested: concentrated sulfuric acid and copper need "concentrated + heat"; dilute sulfuric acid doesn't react with copper; why the lab makes hydrogen with dilute rather than concentrated sulfuric acid.
铜与稀硫酸怎么加热都不反应，只有浓硫酸才把它氧化、放出 SO₂。所以「浓硫酸有强: Copper doesn't react with dilute sulfuric acid however much it's heated; only concentrated acid oxidizes it and releases SO₂. So "concentrated sulfuric acid is strongly oxidizing" comes with conditions: concentrated, and heated.
已经褪成无色的品红，怎么加热一下红颜色又回来了？: Why does magenta that has faded to colorless turn red again when heated?
把已经褪成无色的品红溶液加热（起始未加热）: Heat the magenta solution that has faded to colorless (not heated at the start)
把褪成无色的品红溶液加热：红色回来了，颜色残留从 0.0 % 回到 100.0: Heat the faded magenta solution: the red returns, color remaining goes from 0.0 % back to 100.0 %, while the volume passed is still 10.0 mL (so it isn't that no gas went in); the small reading says "restored"
SO₂ + 某些有色物质 ⇌ 不稳定的无色物质: SO₂ + certain colored substances ⇌ unstable colorless substances
可逆是 SO₂ 漂白与氯水漂白最大的区别：氯水漂白过的品红，加热不会变回来。: Reversibility is the biggest difference between SO₂ bleaching and chlorine-water bleaching: magenta bleached by chlorine water doesn't return when heated.
「红色回来」不等于「SO₂ 消失了」：已通入体积还是 10.0 mL，只是那层无: "Red returning" doesn't mean "the SO₂ is gone": the volume passed is still 10.0 mL; the colorless substance has just been decomposed by heat.
所以工业上用 SO₂ 漂白纸浆、毛、丝，织物的白度会随时间和温度变化 —— 教材: So paper pulp, wool and silk bleached industrially with SO₂ change in whiteness with time and temperature; the textbook says these colorless substances "decompose easily".
去掉这一步：学生只记住「SO₂ 能使品红褪色」，考到「加热后又变红」就答不出原因: Skip this step and students only remember "SO₂ bleaches magenta" and can't explain why it turns red again after heating.
高频：SO₂ 的漂白性与氯水漂白性的区别（可逆 / 不可逆）；品红褪色后加热复原: Frequently tested: the difference between SO₂ bleaching and chlorine-water bleaching (reversible / irreversible); faded magenta restored by heating.
二氧化硫的漂白是与某些有色物质生成不稳定的无色物质，这些无色物质受热容易分解，有: Sulfur dioxide bleaches by forming unstable colorless substances with certain colored substances; these decompose easily on heating and the colored substance regains its original color, so SO₂ bleaching is reversible.
三支检验管与棉团: Three test tubes and cotton plugs
同一股气体，为什么这管只变红、那管紫色却褪了？管口的棉团又是干什么的？: Same gas, so why does this tube only turn red while that one loses its purple? And what are the cotton plugs for?
把导管依次接进三支接收管（品红 → 石蕊 → 酸性 KMnO₄），再留意管口的棉: Connect the delivery tube to the three receiving tubes in turn (magenta → litmus → acidified KMnO₄), then watch the cotton plugs
品红 → 褪成无色（颜色残留 0.0 %）；紫色石蕊 → 只变红、不褪色（颜色残: Magenta → fades to colorless (color remaining 0.0 %); purple litmus → only turns red, doesn't fade (color remaining still 100.0 %); acidified KMnO₄ → purple fades (completely at 5.0 mL passed, color remaining 0.0 %, half what magenta needs), as S is oxidized from +4 to +6. Remove the cotton: a pungent fume trail rises from the mouth and the risk bar climbs to 0.85 (alarm); put it back and the trail disappears, risk 0.10, while the main reading doesn't change at all
